releases.notes:
- Add native settings screens for all three distributions, with optional Mod Menu integration.
- Add an unbound settings control while retaining the existing B visibility toggle.
- Show active rendering, recovery and restart/override status without changing the running renderer.

- Translate settings into all nine existing languages and verify published Mod Menu builds on Java 8.

releases.notes:
- Add an Ornithe Calamus Gen2 distribution alongside both existing Gen1 distributions.
- Reject mismatched mapping generations before activating Minecraft rendering hooks.
- Isolate generation-specific sources, dependencies and build outputs;
  verify all three production distributions and cross-generation rejection in CI.
- Import both Ornithe generations in IntelliJ IDEA with separate source roots,
  mappings, dependencies and client run configurations; build all targets in one invocation.
- Update the build to Gradle 9.2.1, Loom 1.15.5, Legacy Looming 1.15.3 and Ploceus 1.15.9;
  retain Java 8 mod bytecode and runtime support.
- Eliminate toggle-triggered terrain reloads and screen flicker in enhanced mode.
- Add native compatibility and off modes, selected before Mixin transformation. Native
  mode uses coalesced section updates, with an optional full-reload refresh policy.
- Recover from missing enhanced hooks and contained rendering failures by switching
  to native mode; report shared model failures as visualization unavailable.
- Build barrier geometry separately and share translucent draw ordering with existing
  terrain vertices in both adapters, preserving water and glass blending.
- Track barriers through block changes, chunk data updates, unloads, and world changes.
- Preserve lightmap, color, vertex-array and buffer state around barrier drawing,
  including foreign VAOs and element buffers.
- Enforce client-thread index access and non-reentrant rendering; restore graphics
  state before recovery and keep rendering workers separate from mode decisions.
- Keep the barrier frame hook reachable when a mod replaces or cancels terrain drawing.
- Retain compiled vertex origins, shader attributes and sprite ordering with OptiFine;
  restore atlas bindings after multi-texture uploads.
- Document tested rendering mods, supported loader generations, and translucent ordering.
- Add production-namespace compatibility tests for active hitboxes, block highlights,
  chunk grids, orthographic cameras, village markers, custom outlines and waypoint labels.
- Add client regression checks for rendering isolation, state restoration and lifecycle updates.

releases.notes:
- Build Legacy Fabric and Ornithe artifacts from one four-project Gradle build.
- Provision Java toolchains for Gradle and IntelliJ IDEA builds.
- Share dependency-free visibility logic, translations, and barrier assets.
- Enforce client-thread mutation and publish visibility safely to rendering workers.
- Ignore queued toggles outside a world while retaining visibility across connections.
- Declare client-only initialization and explicit runtime dependencies for both artifacts.
- Verify core behavior, release contracts, Java 8 bytecode, metadata, and packaged resources.
- Publish platform-specific SemVer build identifiers through a shared GitHub release pipeline.

# 1.1.0 Ornithe

## Note

**This version has no functional differences from 1.0.1 (Legacy Fabric). It only adds support for the OrnitheMC Loader. Players still using the Legacy Fabric loader with this mod version 1.0.1 do not need to port and update.**

## Changelog

  - Added .gitattributes with line-ending rules and binary markers for Java/Gradle/mod assets.
  - CI workflow now builds on Java 21 with Gradle setup action; dropped Java 17 matrix, wrapper validation, and artifact upload.
  - Build system upgraded to Fabric Loom 1.11 with Ploceus; version string now includes MC version, dependencies switch to Ornithe feather mappings/OSL loader, and Gradle props updated (parallel build,
    loader/feather/OSL versions, mod v1.1.0); wrapper bumped to Gradle 9.2.1 with launcher script adjustments (gradlew, gradlew.bat).
  - Maven repos retargeted to Ornithe releases/snapshots in settings.gradle.
  - Client code ported to Ornithe APIs: keybinding registration now uses KeyBindingEvents/MinecraftClientEvents, barrier block/particle mixins updated to new method names/packages and behavior logging
    tweaked, and block model mixin renamed to BlockModelsMixin with updated injection target.
  - Resource configs streamlined: fabric.mod.json drops dependency/suggests blocks and lvb.mixins.json now references BlockModelsMixin.

## What's Changed
* Ornithe Port by @DaveyL2013 in https://github.com/metaconscious/legacy-visible-barrier/pull/1

## New Contributors

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/metaconscious/legacy-visible-barrier/compare/v1.0.1...v1.1.0

## 1.0.1

### Added
- **Logging**: Introduced logging to `KeyBindings` and `LegacyVisibleBarrierMod` classes for better traceability of key binding registration and barrier visibility toggling.


### Changed
- **Version Bump**: Updated mod version from 1.0.0 to 1.0.1.
- **README.md**: Corrected typos and improved grammar for clarity.

### Fixed
- **Dependencies**: Added Legacy Fabric API as a requirement in `fabric.mod.json`.
- **Icon Update**: Updated `icon.png` to a new version.

**Version 1.0.0**

- **New Features:**
  - Implemented barrier visibility toggling feature using the default keybind `B`. Users can now toggle the visibility of barriers in Minecraft 1.8.9.
  - Added localization support for multiple languages including Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, Russian, English, and German.

- **Enhancements:**
  - Updated the mod's name and functionality in README.md to reflect its purpose of toggling visibility of barriers.
  - Updated `fabric.mod.json` to point to the new repository URL.
  - Defined mod constants for ID, name, and version in the `LegacyVisibleBarrierMod` class.

- **Technical Improvements:**
  - Added barrier block support and modified related mixins to handle rendering and block state mapping.
  - Renamed and updated package structure and JSON metadata to reflect the new mod identity.
  - Updated `gradle.properties` with new Yarn and Fabric versions, and modified Maven group and archive base name.

-  **Requirements**
    - **Legacy Fabric API** ([Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/legacy-fabric-api)/[CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/legacy-fabric-api))

- **Acknowledgments:**
  - This project is inspired by [VisibleBarriers](https://github.com/olvend/VisibleBarriers) created by olvend.
